reviews.t: Your mouth will feel clean and fresh!
reviews.x: This stain remover, use after brushing your teeth with toothpaste. This is excellent for removing built up stains on my teeth. Also you don’t have to use the entire container. Apply a small amount on to your tooth brush, the size of a pea. Then wet the brush and use in a circular motion onto your teeth.

Great product especially for the price.  These cups are small, just like they are in the dentist’s office. I have had it before where if it is hard to scoop, I just scoop it out withy dental hook and place it on the toothbrush.  Great for in between dental visits.  The paste has a lot of flavor.

reviews.t: It annoys me to be cheated
reviews.x: I purchased 14 cups. The package says there should be 14 cups. There are only 13 cups in my unopened package. Believe me - it was no easy feat to turn them all on their heads in the unopened package to show that I was clearly missing one of my cups. I don’t know, yet, if the product is good but it’s very annoying to be cheated right out of the gate. Not a very smart way to retain a customer. Great way to get me to shop elsewhere in the future. One star because I wasn’t allowed to leave zero.

Wish the containers were a little smaller, because I don't use the full amount in the tray, and end up throwing the rest away because I don't want the bacteria to build up on it if I save the remainder.  Works great though!

claims.text: Many reviewers say the product effectively removes stains and brightens teeth, often noticing results after the first use.
Several reviewers report the product arrived dried out, hard, or old, making it difficult to dig out of the container.
Reviewers frequently praise the value and ease of use, noting a small pea-sized amount is enough and the price is reasonable.
Some reviewers mention the taste is pleasant, while others complain of an unpleasant or changed flavor.
A few reviewers report packaging or order problems, such as items arriving loose or short by several units.
